name: Lemon-Lime Soda
siboNotes: Contains high fructose corn syrup which can feed SIBO bacteria. Consider limiting portion sizes and avoiding on empty stomach.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels - some brands use different sweeteners
Dilute with plain sparkling water to reduce FODMAP load
Consume with food to slow absorption
Choose diet versions sweetened with low-FODMAP artificial sweeteners if tolerated
alternatives: Sparkling water with fresh lemon and lime juice
Diet lemon-lime soda (aspartame or stevia sweetened)
Plain soda water with a splash of citrus
nutritionalHighlights: Contains vitamin C from citrus flavoring
